decisionsTitle: The waiting-list setting says what it does, and the backoffice spells «BIB» one way
decisionsSection:
Two wording changes, no behaviour.

**A. The setting's name.** §615 named the editor's «Da»/«Nu» select «Ofertele din lista de așteptare pleacă automat». The owner (2026-10-01) asked for it to say what it does: «Locurile din lista de așteptare se alocă automat» (en «Places from the waiting list are allocated automatically»). The help now reads «Pe „Da”, un loc eliberat sau adăugat se alocă pe loc primului de pe lista de așteptare. Pe „Nu”, locurile rămân libere până le dai tu, cu „Trimite-i oferta”.» (and its English twin); «Da»/«Nu» stay, and `waitlistAutoOfferHelpMore` keeps its content. Every place that quoted the old label follows: the guide's steps (§620) and the two guide sentences that said the offers «nu pleacă automat», `SETUP.md` §39's recipe, code comments and the tests that assert the words. The column `events.waitlist_auto_offer`, its values, the audit action `event.waitlist_auto_offer_changed` and the behaviour are untouched.

**B. «BID» becomes «BIB».** The backoffice's catalogue strings said «BID» for the race number; the term is BIB. Romanian keeps the hyphenated forms of today's «BID-ul»: «BIB-ul», «BIB-uri», «BIB-urile». Changed in both catalogues (the printing mark, the desk guide, the start list's toggle and alt text, the guide's steps) and in the e2e assertions. Not touched, on purpose: the journey chip «nr. {number}» / «no. {number}» and the desk's «Salvează nr.» — the owner asked for the column's and the technical term's spelling, not every short form; and the owner's quoted words in code comments, which keep their original spelling. «FORBIDDEN» is not the race number and stays.

Refused: a new key, an ICU change, any migration.
changelogLine: **«Locurile din lista de așteptare se alocă automat», and «BIB» everywhere** — the setting says what it does; the backoffice spells the race number's term one way. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the event editor, when it draws the waiting-list setting, then its label is «Locurile din lista de așteptare se alocă automat» (en «Places from the waiting list are allocated automatically») and its help says that on «Da» a freed or added place is allocated at once to the first on the list and on «Nu» it stays free until the club gives it with «Trimite-i oferta», and the guide, `SETUP.md` and the tests quote the same words; the column, its values and the behaviour are unchanged (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the backoffice in either language, when it names the race number's printing mark, the desk guide's numbers or the start list's toggle, then it spells the term «BIB» («BIB-ul», «BIB-uri», «BIB-urile» in Romanian) and never «BID»; the short forms «nr.» and «no.» are unchanged (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: waiting-list setting renamed «Locurile din lista de așteptare se alocă automat»; «BID» → «BIB» in the catalogues (§NNN)
